programmes.d: In homes across America, there were images of unimaginable violence: four white police officers viciously beat a man on the ground. Years of accusations of police brutality suddenly became flesh and blood in a man named Rodney King.

The practice of Evangelism, the spreading of the Christian Gospel, is as old as Christianity itself, but the advent of television gave the Christian crusaders a new and powerful means of communication.
In the 20s there seemed to be some good candidates for leadership in Europe. But where were these people when the great depression hits, affecting the lives of people around the world?
Three movements to discover where we are.
Three ways in which man harvests the world's natural resources.
Eddie 'The Fat Man' Jackson and Courtney 'The Field Marshal' Brown were labeled 'Kingpins' in an era where their names reigned supreme in Detroit.

The big hair, lacy cuffs, the platform shoes... Yes, Louis XIV was over the top, and nobody outshone The Sun King. He may have been pint-sized, but Louis had a huge appetite for sex, food, and bling. Welcome to the Secret Life of Louis XIV.
Born in the Dakota Hills, Sitting Bull became a leader during the Great Sioux Wars. Present day descendants help to tell his story and the developments leading to the Battle of Little Big Horn.
Billy the Kid uses his talents with a gun to get what he wants. Wyatt Earp fights for justice. Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse make a big decision.
Join us as we explore one of Egypt's biggest mysteries, the Great Pyramid.
Which 10 events will stay in our minds and hearts as those that marked history?
Both political and military expediency were factors in the return of the French capital to its people.
The Allies launch an attack designed to push the Germans back to the Rhine River.
Odin, who wants Sigurd dead so he can recruit him, reveals to Brynhild the deception she has fallen victim to.
Odin questions a seer, who reveals new details about Ragnarök.
A banquet is held in Asgard, during which Loki insults the gods, revealing their weaknesses. His punishment is terrible.

Rome deals with conflict at home. At Pompeii and Fidenae we discover the clues to the huge wealth that flooded the Republic – but divided society. We meet the unlikely champion of the people who brought an end to this rampant inequality.
Trace the spiritual history of the Mediterranean Basin, examining the ancient cultures that have greatly influenced the religions of the modern world.
An overview of the largest stone giants, unveiling their construction secrets and origins.
The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries.
The Trojans are surprised to discover that the Greeks have suddenly left the shores of Troy, leaving only a wooden horse. Inside the horse, Greek warriors remain silent and still.
